definition: Kling AI is a generative artificial intelligence service created and hosted by the Beijing-based technology company Kuaishou.
details: Kling generates videos from natural language descriptions, called prompts.

explainer.lead: Kling AI is a generative AI service from Kuaishou that turns natural-language prompts into video. It matters because it brings prompt-driven video generation to a hosted product rather than a research demo.

tiers.eli5: You type a description of a scene, and the service makes a short video of it.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers prompt Kling with text descriptions to produce video clips. A pitfall is treating prompt wording as the whole problem when video output quality also depends on how well the prompt describes the scene.
tiers.paperLevel: Formally, Kling AI is a hosted generative model that maps a text prompt to a video. No published limits are specified here.

explainer.example: An engineer writes a prompt describing a scene and receives a generated video clip in return.

usedIn.name: Kuaishou
usedIn.detail: company that created and hosts it
